score_rationale: Margaret Hamilton has mobile app development experience and demonstrates a results-oriented approach but lacks the essential web development skills and team management experience required for this Engineering Manager role.
key_strengths: Mobile app development experience (demonstrating adaptability and technical skills) and experience improving product quality.
key_weaknesses: Lack of experience with the required web technologies (React/TypeScript, Node.js or .NET) and proven team management/leadership of engineering teams through significant technical change.
final_evaluation: Margaret Hamilton is not a suitable candidate for the Web Development Engineering Manager role at Northlight Digital due to the critical gaps in both the required web technologies and lack of leadership experience directly applicable to this position.
